title: Sara Duterte spox says NBI’s SALN report ‘a shameless smear campaign’
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesperson on Friday said the National Bureau of Investigation’s (NBI) report on her alleged property misdeclarations was part of a “shameless smear campaign.”
